meta.objective: Migrate moon_flutter_core to Mix v2 patterns while keeping the core headless, minimal, and analyzer-clean.

doc.purpose: Mix v2 token APIs and migration notes
Reference behaviours and advanced patterns from Mix core

analyzerIssues.summary: Style() constructor removed, $on.* API deprecated, gap/withOpacity/shade helpers deprecated, widespread mix v1 usage.

dependency.name: mix
dependency.note: New fluent stylers, MixScope tokens, RowBox/FlexBox widgets, state variants like onHovered.

currentState.constraint: Keep Dart style (2-space indent, 80 column) and ASCII output.
Use Mix v2 fluent APIs (BoxStyler(), TextStyler(), $box.color...) and variant helpers (.onHovered, .onFocused, etc.).
Initial cleanup must delete generated *.g.dart files before other refactors.

task.title: Confirm Mix v2 foundations
task.description: Digest Mix v2 API surface and align migration strategy before touching code.
task.todo: Re-read .llms/mix-scope-and-theming.md and token-migration-guide.md; note MixScope wiring expectations while reaffirming that Moon core stays token-agnostic.
Skim relevant sections of .llms/examples.xml (components, fluent API, RowBox/FlexBox, Pressable) to capture canonical patterns.
Document key deltas vs Mix v1 (no Style(), deprecated $on, gap → spacing, Color.withValues) in a short internal note (docs/mix_v2_notes.md) to guide later tasks.
task.definitionOfDone: Reference note committed alongside migration outlining MixScope setup, fluent styler usage, and variant conversion rules.

task.title: Repository hygiene & generated file purge
task.description: Remove stale generated assets and baseline tool state ahead of refactors.
task.todo: Locate and delete all *.g.dart (and other stale generated artifacts) across repo; ensure .gitignore prevents regeneration.
Remove obsolete build/ outputs or cached analyzer JSON that will be regenerated (verify necessity with maintainers if uncertain).
Run flutter pub get to refresh dependency graph after deletions.
task.definitionOfDone: Working tree free of generated files, pubspec.lock unchanged aside from dependency resolution, flutter pub get succeeds.

task.title: Baseline diagnostics snapshot
task.description: Capture current analyzer/test output to track migration progress.
task.todo: Run dart analyze --format json and store results at tools/reports/analyze.pre_migration.json for comparison.
Attempt flutter test -r expanded; save failing summary (even if failing) to tools/reports/tests.pre_migration.txt.
task.definitionOfDone: Pre-migration analyzer and test snapshots stored under tools/reports/.

task.title: Headless core guardrails
task.description: Establish guardrails that keep lib/ free of opinionated styling while adopting Mix v2.
task.todo: Audit existing components for baked-in colors, spacing, or typography and document extraction targets for the example layer.
Outline the "component trio" workflow (core widget, tests, example) to apply consistently through the migration.
task.definitionOfDone: Guidelines committed detailing headless expectations and trio workflow; core components limited to structural defaults only.

task.title: Upgrade custom Mix infrastructure
task.description: Align Moon-specific mix utilities/modifiers with Mix v2 core semantics.
task.todo: Audit lib/src/mix/attributes (MoonBorderMix, variants) to ensure they extend Style<Spec> correctly and expose fluent APIs matching Mix v2 (Prop.maybeMix, .onHovered, etc.).
Refactor lib/src/mix/modifiers/* to new WidgetModifier APIs (ensure utilities return MixUtility<T, ModifierMix> and expose wrap helpers).
Replace deprecated helpers ($with.*, Interactable) with Mix v2 equivalents (wrapOpacity, WidgetModifierConfig, Pressable) across mix extensions.
Add regression tests (if feasible) covering Moon modifiers resolving correctly via StyleSpecBuilder (lib or test/mix_modifiers_test.dart).
task.definitionOfDone: Custom mix utilities compile against Mix v2, expose fluent builder surface, and are covered by sanity tests.

task.title: Refactor base interactive primitives
task.description: Migrate MoonBaseInteractiveWidget, selection widgets, and overlay primitives to typed stylers.
task.todo: Change style-typed properties from Style? to BoxStyler?/FlexBoxStyler? as appropriate; add generic type params if needed.
Replace Interactable usages with Pressable or Mix widget state controllers; ensure WidgetStatesController wiring remains intact.
Ensure base widgets expose style hooks without introducing default padding, colors, or typography.
Update unit tests (base_interactive_widget_test, base_single_select_widget_test, base_multi_select_widget_test, base_overlay_widget_test) to assert headless behaviour and state wiring.
task.definitionOfDone: Base primitives compile with Mix v2 stylers, tests updated and passing.

task.title: Component migration: interactive & surface widgets
task.description: Port buttons, chips, tags, avatars, breadcrumb, menu item, segmented tab control, carousel to Mix v2 fluent APIs.
task.todo: Rewrite component style builders to use BoxStyler()/FlexBoxStyler() fluent chains (no Style() constructor, no $on.* pipes).
Replace StyledRow/StyledColumn with RowBox/ColumnBox (or FlexBox.createWidget) and update spacing() usage instead of gap().
Ensure components rely on passed stylers/state rather than hard-coded colors or spacing.
Update public APIs to return typed stylers (e.g., MoonButtonStyle builder returns BoxStyler) or builder delegates as needed and adjust exports.
Refresh component tests (button, chip, tag, avatar, breadcrumb, segmented_tab_control, carousel) to assert new style wiring.
task.definitionOfDone: All interactive surface widgets compile with new stylers, remain headless, and have tests covering primary states.

task.title: Component migration: inputs & form controls
task.description: Migrate text inputs, form inputs, auth code, progress pin, radio, checkbox, switch to Mix v2.
task.todo: Refactor text input style pipeline: replace Style.merge/add with BoxStyler().merge, RowBox, wrapDefaultTextStyle, onFocused/onError variants.
Rewrite form/auth code containers to use BoxStyler.wrap* and expose border builders without embedding palette choices.
Update selection controls (radio, checkbox, switch) to use WidgetStatesController + onSelected/onDisabled stylers, cleaning up toggle logic.
Revisit MoonMessage/validation error rendering to rely on TextStyler hooks and structural spacing only.

Update associated widget tests (text_input_test, form_text_input_test, auth_code_test, switch_test, base_single_select_widget_test, base_multi_select_widget_test, progress_pin tests) to reflect new stylers and states.
task.definitionOfDone: Form controls fully migrated, tests green, no remaining Style() usage in input stack.

task.title: Component migration: feedback & overlays
task.description: Migrate alerts, toasts, modals, bottom sheets, popovers, tooltips, loaders, progress indicators.
task.todo: Update container stylers to BoxStyler fluent API (wrapOpacity, wrapPadding, animate(AnimationConfig)).
Ensure transitions use Mix v2 animation helpers (AnimationConfig.easeInOut, keyframes where relevant).
Replace deprecated Color.withOpacity/shade access with withValues() or consumer-supplied colors.
Update tests (alert_test, toast_test, modal_test, bottom_sheet_test, tooltip_test, linear_progress_indicator_test, circular_progress_indicator_test, loaders) to new stylers.
task.definitionOfDone: Feedback/overlay widgets compile, remain headless, pass tests, and no deprecated APIs remain.

task.title: Example app & documentation refresh
task.description: Bring example/ and docs in sync with new API.
task.todo: Rewrite example/src/common_styles.dart and styled_components/* to use fluent $box/$flex APIs, RowBox, BoxStyler.onHovered, etc.
Swap StyledRow/StyledColumn for RowBox/ColumnBox and replace gap() with spacing().
Provide example-level MixScope/token wiring (outside of lib/) and ensure the sample still runs.
Refresh README usage snippets to demonstrate Mix v2 pattern (e.g., BoxStyler().color($brandPrimary()), onHovered).
Add MIGRATION.md summarising breaking changes for downstream consumers.
task.definitionOfDone: Example app builds, docs updated, MIGRATION.md present.

task.title: Deprecated API & color cleanup
task.description: Eliminate lingering deprecated Flutter or Mix API usage.
task.todo: Replace Color.withOpacity -> withValues(), Color.alpha/red/green/blue -> .a/.r/.g/.b per flutter lint guidance.
Swap Colors.grey.shade* to ColorScheme or Colors.grey(*).
Ensure no references to gap, $with, Interactable, StyledRow remain (use ripgrep audit).
task.definitionOfDone: rg checks confirm absence of deprecated symbols, analyzer reports zero deprecated_member_use.

task.title: Test suite expansion & stabilization
task.description: Strengthen automated coverage for Mix-driven components.
task.todo: Add golden/widget tests for key stylers (e.g., BoxStyler resolves expected colors when provided) referencing .llms/tests.xml patterns.
Create integration test verifying example-level theming flows through MixScope across components (flutter_test using WidgetTester).
Ensure tests run deterministically with WidgetStatesController; add helpers under test/utils/.
task.definitionOfDone: New/updated tests in place, flutter test -r expanded passes locally.

task.title: Project polish & CI readiness
task.description: Finalize migration, ensure quality gates, and document release.
task.todo: Run dart format . and dart analyze (expect zero issues).
Run flutter test -r expanded; ensure widget goldens updated if needed.
Update CHANGELOG.md with breaking Mix v2 migration notes and instructions.
Prepare release checklist (docs/release_notes/mix_v2_migration.md) summarising key API changes, testing performed, known follow-ups.
task.definitionOfDone: Analyser/test suites green, docs updated, release notes ready.
